title: Jedi Temple Siege
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: On that fateful night Supreme Chancellor Palpatine issued Order 66, clone troopers of the 501st, led by Darth Vader, attacked the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. No one was spared the violence, including the younglings. Grogu had blocked out the painful memory of watching three Jedi fall in their attempt to battle the clone trooper army.
